name: Billdad
description: A small, kangaroo-legged, hawk-billed amphibious creature of North American lumberjack folklore, said to live only at Boundary Pond in northwestern Maine and to fish by leaping over surface fish and stunning them with a tail-slap.

aliases.name: Saltipiscator falcorostratus
aliases.meaning: 'Leaping fisher with the falcon's beak' — humorous binomial in W. T. Cox (1910)

origin: Localised exclusively to Boundary Pond in northwestern Maine, on the Canadian border, per Cox (1910).
